title: Guidance: CFG and what it really does
hook: One line of arithmetic, and it does not sample the distribution people usually say it does.

verified.claim: cfg_function computes uncond + (cond minus uncond) times cfg on denoised predictions, and runs any post-cfg hooks after it.
sampling_function drops the second conditioning when cfg is close to 1, unless disable_cfg1_optimization is set.
The two predictions may share one batch when memory allows.
On a toy with exact predictions, samples leave the tilted density as cfg rises.
The cfg 7 and 14 pictures and their figures come from the same seed and graph.

unchecked: The wipe is one prompt and one seed on SDXL. It shows what happened, not what always happens.
We quote the papers' statements on what CFG samples. We did not re-derive their proofs.
